name: Video Embed JW Player
description: JW Player provider for Video Embed Field.
project_description:
This module provides JW Player + JW Platform handler for Video Embed Field.

Users can add JW Platform videos to their site by entering the video's embed url.

 Acceptable url formats for entry into a video embed field: 

 
 Iframe embed url: //cdn.jwplayer.com/players/MEDIAID-PLAYERID.html OR //content.jwplatform.com/players/MEDIAID-PLAYERID.html 
 JS embed url: //cdn.jwplayer.com/players/MEDIAID-PLAYERID.js OR //content.jwplatform.com/players/MEDIAID-PLAYERID.js 
 Preview url: https://cdn.jwplayer.com/previews/MEDIAID-PLAYERID OR https://content.jwplatform.com/previews/MEDIAID-PLAYERID 
 Catch all: Any url with //SUBDOMAIN.jwplayer.com/SOMETHING/MEDIAID-PLAYERID OR //SUBDOMAIN.jwplatform.com/SOMETHING/MEDIAID-PLAYERID 
 
 Video Embed Output:

 
 Iframe embed: https://support.jwplayer.com/articles/how-to-create-a-reproduction-page 
 
 JW Player Embedding Support:

 
 SUPPORTED: JW Player (Cloud) + JW Platform . 
 SUPPORTED: JW Player (Cloud) + Externally-Hosted Content . 
 NOT SUPPORTED: JW Player (Self-Hosted) + JW Platform . 
 NOT SUPPORTED: JW Player (Self-Hosted) + Externally-Hosted Content . 
 
 Currently Unsupported:

 
 Embeds with SEO meta tags. 
 
 Requires:

 
 Video Embed Field 
 
 Recommended:

 
 Entity Embed patch: [#2882866] - This patch allows a custom view mode to be used when the media video is rendered inside of the editor. Example: Media video configured with a "WYSIWYG" view mode that renders the "Thumbnail" with "Medium" image style.
